# Pinned Slug WGSL reference

These files are byte-for-byte snapshots of `diffusionstudio/slug-webgpu` at revision `12d8bdf333263c1340a7ca5de0c36f7f90721be0`. `UPSTREAM.json` records the original paths, Git blob IDs and SHA-256 hashes. `LICENSE` is copied verbatim too. The full reference clones remain ignored under `third_party/clone/`.

The WGSL files are review references, not runtime inputs. MusArt uses Three.js TSL and Three's WebGPU/WebGL backends. See [the function mapping and explicit adaptations](../../docs/rendering/slug-port.md) and the preserved [Eric Lengyel](../../docs/legal/slug-eric-lengyel-MIT.txt) / [Konstantin Paulus](../../docs/legal/slug-webgpu-MIT.txt) MIT notices.
